title: Honeymoon Tour Vietnam 14 Days 13 Nights
summary: Discover Hanoi’s best-known landmarks. Enjoy a home-hosted dinner. Visit Ky Son and Duong Lam ancient village to experience the traditional life and authentic culture in the countryside of Vietnam.
inclusions: Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C vehicles, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.
html:
Sightseeing Highlights

  • Discover Hanoi’s best-known landmarks. Enjoy a home-hosted dinner

  • Visit Ky Son and Duong Lam ancient village to experience the traditional life and authentic culture in the countryside of Vietnam

  • Take the overnight cruise trip, Admire Bai Tu Long Bay’s majestic beauty.

  • Explore the weaving laneways of historic Hoi An ancient town on the banks of the Thu Bon River by bicycle ride. Join exciting basket boat activity in Cam Thanh village.

  • Enjoy a day of snorkeling in the waters around Cham Island and discover its amazing sea life

  • Experience and relax in a spectacular setting in a dramatic bay that gives the feeling of being on an exclusive private island resort in the East Vietnam Sea, “hidden” Ninh Van Bay

  • Visit Ho Chi Minh City landmarks: War Remnant Museum, Notre Dame Cathedral, Reunification Palace, and Ben Thanh Market…etc.

  • Take a day trip to the Mekong Delta to discover the hidden waterways.

Dining Experience

  • 13 hotel buffet breakfasts
  • 5 dinners and 6 lunches at well-selected restaurants and local homes

What’s Included?

  • Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C vehicles, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.

What’s Not Included?

  • Your international flights from and to Vietnam, entry visa to Vietnam, personal expenses, tips to guide and driver.
outline: Day 2: Hanoi – 1/2 Day City tour – Home hosted dinner
Day 3: Hanoi – Ky Son Village – Moon Garden Homestay
Day 4: Ky Son – Halong Bay – Bai Tu Long Bay
Day 5: Bai Tu Long Bay – Hanoi – Flight to Da Nang/ Hoi An
Day 6: Hoi An – Walking Tour & Secluded Rice Field Dinner
Day 7: Hoi An – Cham Island Snorkeling & Excursion
Day 8: Hoi An – Danang – Flight to Nha Trang
Day 12: Nha Trang – Fight to Ho Chi Minh City – Evening Romantic Cruise Dinner
Day 13: HCM City – A Taste of the Mekong
